noel_regression_after_sopia: All 16,000 shared no-god/current-Noel combat results exactly match the previous verified dataset.

followup_screen01.scope: Eight gods; baseline/passive/paced plus prepared sensitivity for Polka/Koyori/Okayu. Exploratory reuse of v3 seeds, not independent confirmation.

policy_confirmation01.scope: Isolated headless action-selection experiment; production engine/UI not replaced.

five_god_depth02.design_conformance: not_complete: Mela fire beam extra halving omitted; static audit documented, correction/end-to-end regression deferred to separate frozen version.
five_god_depth02.safety_fix: Isolated AoE null/alive guards for native summoner-linked removal; four real battlesphere regression paths passed.
five_god_depth02.baseline_policy: Original v3; does not combine previous selective policy recommendations.
five_god_depth02.scope: Fixed kits and 14 native monster panels; persistent Polka three-fight series without XP/piety income. Not campaign or normal worship/UI integration.

mela.name: 메라
mela.reason: Strong breath/ember contributions, but actual fire-beam extra ultimate halving is omitted. Correct implementation in a separate version before final numerical judgment.

vivi.name: 비비
vivi.reason: Burst removal harms melee/ranged with family95 intervals below zero; blind-only and ultimate contrasts remain uncertain. Review burst damage/multitarget efficiency before broad control nerfs.

miko.name: 미코
miko.reason: Fire removal harms magic by5.5pp; melee boundary damage is zero under adjacent-start stationary placement. Keep current numbers pending terrain/position testing; paid pre-shrine differences uncertain.

lui.name: 루이
lui.reason: Paid pre-flock helps melee9.75pp; command removal hurts melee5.5pp but helps magic4pp. Preserve raven coefficients and separate action policy by build; magic still trails no-god.

polka.name: 폴카
polka.reason: Banked AP improves single fights, but persistent initial-zero series does not access finale. Early/mid piety remains below unlock despite some AP banking; late fresh-zero AP stays below3. Test performance targeting and campaign carry before adjusting income/finisher coefficients.

vfxDraftHandoff.next: Ayame2-star zanshin implemented and validated. No new VFX claimed. Next original-order god Choco. Vivi/Sopia/Mela combat redesigns remain pending.

suiseiThreeStarDraft.userDirection: Reduce maximum stars from 5 to 3 and retune related effects because targets often die before five stacks.

tier3.damage: 2d(8+floor(I/2))+5*S against marked target; base damage only against other targets

tier5.damage: 3d(10+floor(I/2))+8*S against snapshotted marked target; base damage only against other targets

suiseiThreeStarDraft.pietyMarkedKillBonus: Keep existing threshold S>=3: now requires full stacks. Other eligibility rules unchanged.
suiseiThreeStarDraft.visualProposal: Approved indicator now connected to ordinary gameplay: cyan1/2 and gold3 above marked enemy.

unapprovedPassiveCandidates.focusedObservation: If retained, ordinary accuracy +3 against marked target at S>=2; auto-hit and MR checks unaffected.
unapprovedPassiveCandidates.starInheritance: Retain user-preferred start at 2/3: only when existing kill-reward bonus hits a new marked target and it survives. Not implemented.

constraints: Faster full stacks are a real buff; maximum damage preserved approximately, not a balance-equivalence claim.
Keep original one-stack-per-damaging-action, exclusion, consumption, miss, expiry, friendly-fire and reward anti-recursion rules unless separately changed.
suiseiThreeStarDraft.saveMigration: Legacy v1 Suisei stars ceil(3*S/5), cap3; keep already-rolled reward and preserve +5/old-star bonus of already queued comets. New Suisei payload v2. Other gods remain v1.

suiseiFocusDraft.name: 집중 관측
suiseiFocusDraft.condition: Current marked target alive, mark unexpired, at least2of3 stars.
suiseiFocusDraft.effect: Accuracy +3 on attacks with ordinary hit checks, including melee/ranged and eligible attack spells. No damage bonus. Auto-hit attacks and MR checks unaffected.
suiseiFocusDraft.cost: No activation, MP, piety consumption, extra action or star consumption.
suiseiFocusDraft.scaling: Fixed +3; does not scale with Invocations or increase hit chance by a flat3 percentage points.
suiseiFocusDraft.visualDirection: Use the approved 2/3-star indicator to recognize eligibility; no new large effect required.

suiseiInheritance.name: 별의 계승
suiseiInheritance.effect: Consume the existing next-hit kill reward on a fresh marked foe. If the ordinary direct attack deals positive damage and the foe survives, start at2stars rather than1.
suiseiInheritance.cost: No additional MP/piety/action/star cost. Original attack/spell cost applies.
constraints: One-shot and reward-only kills give no inherited stars or recursive reward.
An already stacked target gains the normal1 only, max3.
Divine powers and DoT/pet damage do not trigger inheritance.
suiseiInheritance.save: Banked reward already uses saved offence/three_end fields; inheritance flag is per-action only. Native bank-save, actual next spell outcomes and strict ordinary-combat RNG continuation verified. Full post-targeting-UI RNG equality is logged separately.

mikoShrine557.tier2Passive: Proposal only: heal2+Inv/6, overflow shield cap4+Inv/3. Not implemented.

mikoPassive.visual: Approved green cross,five blossoms,pale circular barrier now connected to actual kills and shield.

akiFullKit.save: Existing saved rest[0] cooldown; no serializer layout changes.

fubukiOpening.name: 여우의 빈틈
fubukiOpening.trigger: First successful ordinary direct hit on living deceived foe; only its deceiving image fires extra, once per successful deception.
fubukiOpening.cost: No extra MP/piety/action. Same native hit/resistance/time-scaling as ordinary foxfire.
fubukiOpening.save: Existing Fubuki target.kind:0unspent/1spent. Reset on successful deception. Existing raven_hits stores deceiving image and expiry. No serializer layout changes.

ayameZanshin.save: Existing saved tertiary expiry; action-only eligibility/snapshot fields are transient. No serializer layout changes.
